title: (Bare Metals: Big Cannons) Big Cannons x Barebones
description: This pack is to be used with Create: Big Cannons to make it fit the 'trailer' vibe that Barebones gives
body:
![Pack title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77e1070d3627726433f6bdf8c917f8764b265aba.png)

![Pack title 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f163ca4fa4f4536cdc66963ee89f06f1bec66358.png)

The Big Cannons mod must be installed to notice any difference. 

Get it [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons)


This pack adds compatibility between the [Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons) mod and the BareBones resource pack.

![Big Cannon's blocks in the BareBones style](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f8e8cc2947e64740bf6bce14832bab655053476.png)

**Apply ABOVE Big cannon's pack in the resource pack menu**
